svg.text: ESP32-S3 pin map. Pins are drawn in wiring order, not board order: match them by the GPIO number printed on the board.
LEDs: long leg (+) toward the resistor, short leg (−, flat side of the rim) to GND. Right-hand jumpers link the top and bottom rails.
Everything runs on 3.3 V from the board (USB powered). Keep the display wires short, under about 15 cm.
